text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while talking to Yamanin Zephyr in my office…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A storm-force wind rages inside my head…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: These winds wreak havoc as they rush across the fields, but they can be endured if you hide inside a thicket of trees…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I doubt there are any thickets in my head, though…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I do hope it calms down soon… Ow, ow, ow…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Yamanin Zephyr's headache is really bothering her.
